title: Fourier component with prescribed support
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be an orthonormal basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ for the $\pi$-weighted inner product, with one basis vector equal to the constant-one function. Let its index set be finite and nonempty, let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $J$ be a subset of the coordinates. The Fourier component of $f$ with support exactly $J$ is the sum, over multi-indices whose support is $J$, of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ times the corresponding product basis function.
hypotheses_covered: basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
